$sprite_notes: Unit sheets: rows = 8 facings N,NE,E,SE,S,SW,W,NW (row 0 faces away from the camera), cols = frames, grid in assets/frames.json. Team colour: palette ramp 224..238 is normalised to pure (0,g,0) by the extractor; recolour at runtime (godot/shaders/team_recolor.gdshader, game/js/sprites.js teamSource). Translucency: RS sheets encode shadow as FA runs (alpha 112) and FB-FE edge levels; RL sheets use the magenta ramp 250..254 -> translucent black (ghosts, mage cloaks). Effects: alpha = brightness (additive emulation).
$comment: Contract for the entry-level `resources` key added to every entry of data/*.json (characters, classes, creatures, effects, skills, actions, terrain_items, elements). It sits NEXT to `versions`, is not versioned/voted, and only points at curated free assets under chaosD6/assets/. All paths are relative to the chaosD6 repo root and mirror the layout of chaos_mapper/extracted (extracted/Sprites/Units/... -> assets/Sprites/Units/...). Frame grids for every sheet live in assets/frames.json keyed by the same relative path.

resources.match_reason: why this asset was chosen (meaning / name / stats / tags)

idle.usage: 8-direction idle loop (rows = directions N,NE,E,SE,S,SW,W,NW (row 0 faces away from camera); cols = frames), grid in assets/frames.json

walk.usage: 8-direction walk cycle, play while moving along the hex path

attack.usage: 8-direction attack, play on action A / skill

death.usage: death strip, play once when life reaches 0

fidget.usage: 8-direction idle variation, play randomly while idle

cast.usage: 8-direction spell cast, play on effect/skill use

info.usage: info panel image: portrait on top, team-coloured UI icons below

static.usage: single still image (buildings, terrain items, misc)

effect.usage: effect animation strip (cols = frames), play at target hex; blend: additive for fire/light effects

portrait.usage: hero/character portrait for HUD and roster

tiles.usage: terrain tile block (8-bit 320x240 tile sheet) for hexes of this terrain

ready.usage: play when the entity spawns / is recruited

order.usage: play when an action is queued / a target is set

deathblow.usage: play when the entity kills a target

conversion.usage: play when capturing a terrain item

frames_json_entry.$comment: assets/frames.json: one entry per sheet, keyed by the relative asset path
